title: Google Business Profile
summary: Setup and monthly care for the listing that shows up in Google Maps and the map pack.
metaTitle: Google Business Profile Management | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Google Business Profile setup and monthly management for Western Slope businesses, included in the $850 and $1,500 plans.
body:
For a lot of local companies, the Google listing is the real homepage. It is where the phone number, the hours, the reviews, and the photos get judged in a few seconds.

Setup is included with the $1,000 website build and with both monthly plans. Monthly care covers posts, review replies, category checks, and cleanup when spam or a duplicate shows up. You keep ownership of the profile. I should never be the only person who can get into it.
gets: Claim or cleanup of the existing profile
Categories, services, and attributes matched to the work you want
Photos and weekly posts on a monthly plan
Review request setup and replies in your voice
A monthly note on calls, clicks, and direction requests

steps.title: Get access
steps.text: We confirm who owns the profile and remove old managers who should not be there.

steps.title: Make the record true
steps.text: Name, phone, hours, services, and description get aligned with the website.

steps.title: Keep it active
steps.text: On a monthly plan I post, watch reviews, and fix problems before they sit for a month.

faqs.q: My profile was suspended. Can you help?
faqs.a: Often, yes. I review what Google flagged, gather the documents they ask for, and file a reinstatement. Simple cases move in days. Messy cases take longer, and I will tell you which one yours looks like.

They are a small part of the picture, not a magic lever. They give the listing fresh offers and a link back to the right page. I include them on the monthly plans because a silent listing looks neglected.
You do. I will not build a profile that only I can access. If I am removed as a manager, the listing stays yours.

faqs.q: Is this a separate bill from the monthly plan?
faqs.a: No. Profile setup and monthly management are inside GBP + Website at $850 and the AI plan at $1,500. The website build also includes setup.
